headings.reviewNote: Distinguishes the court-authorized disposal/compromise of bad or doubtful debts and release of assigned interests; best-interest conditions remain in the text.

headings.title: Notice, reporting, objections, and court approval
headings.reviewNote: Read report timing, creditor objections, approval before finality, and pre-application notice; avoids turning conditional court-term timing into an absolute deadline.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Court orders concern bad or doubtful debts and assigned interests subject to estate-benefit conditions. The procedural heading includes notice before obtaining the order, reporting, creditor objections, and final court approval without making conditional term-based deadlines absolute. This is not independent legal review.
